status.summary: The City of New Albany's data-center site, in its version modified on 26 August 2026, says the City 'is working to address noise complaints from neighbors near two active data center sites, one operated by Google and one operated by Meta', and that residents near 'Google's New Albany campus' reported noise from cooling fans, which Google is mitigating through sound monitoring, operational adjustments and sound-dampening materials, with a permanent solution scheduled for December 2026. This government statement records Google's New Albany campus as an active, Google-operated data-centre site on 26 August 2026, the modification day of the captured version (bounded by the Internet Archive copy of 6 September 2026 and the version's own reference to July 2026). It is not an opening, inspection or commissioning date; capacity, the number of buildings in service and occupancy are not established.

locator.identity_review: The City lists HJS at 2565 Harrison Road. A site-address query of the Licking County parcel layer returns exactly one parcel at that address, 095-112044-00.000 in the City of New Albany, Jersey Township, owned by Montauk Innovations LLC, classed industrial vacant land with no assessed improvements and created by a split on 4 June 2026. status.summary: DataBank's news item of 10 August 2026 says, in DataBank's own words, that 'The Orangeburg facility supports healthcare, banking, and other digital services, and is one of several data centers located in the town', that DataBank 'is seeking to expand the existing site', and that the expansion is undergoing a full environmental impact study before it can go to the Orangetown Planning Board. The Orangeburg facility is LGA3, the campus's only built data center (DataBank says LGA4 'will be our second facility'). This records LGA3 as operating on 10 August 2026, the item's publication day; it is not an opening date, and the 20 MW is DataBank's stated critical IT load, not load in service. The expansion is not part of this record.

additions.successor_review: DataBank's LGA3 page (version of 17 September 2026) still calls LGA3 the data center that 'anchors our new campus' with 20 MW, and the Orangeburg Campus page (version of 26 September 2026) still says the campus is home to LGA3 and LGA4; neither reports a pause or closure. The NYS DEC Environmental Notice Bulletin of 2 September 2026 lists a SEQR item 'Town of Orangetown - DataBank Orangeburg Phase Two' (DEC sitemap entry, local dec-sitemap-p8.xml), but the notice page returned HTTP 403 and has no archived copy, so it is not used; that expansion is a separate future project. No later status for LGA3 was found. 10 August 2026 is 74 days before a 23 October 2026 update and stays within 90 days until 8 November 2026.
